rows.known_text: if she wanted to she could start
rows.target_text: やりたければ始められる

rows.known_text: she could come tomorrow if she wanted to
rows.target_text: 明日やりたければ来られる

rows.known_text: she could write it now if she wanted to
rows.target_text: 今やりたければ書ける

rows.known_text: she could stay longer if she wanted to
rows.target_text: もっと長くいられる、やりたければ

rows.known_text: i think she could start tomorrow if she wanted to
rows.target_text: 明日やりたければ始められると思う

rows.known_text: she might be able to come on monday if she wanted to
rows.target_text: 月曜やりたければ来られるかもしれない

rows.known_text: i'm not sure if she could write it if she wanted to
rows.target_text: やりたければ書けるかどうか分からない

rows.known_text: i wonder if she could use this room if she wanted to
rows.target_text: やりたければこの部屋使えるか気になる

rows.known_text: she could start next week if she wanted to
rows.target_text: 来週始められる、やりたければ

rows.known_text: if she wanted to she could write a letter to his friend
rows.target_text: やりたければ友だちに手紙書ける
